description: HGM7100N series genset controllers (auto start; HGM7120N adds mains monitoring and transfer): alarm flags, mains and generator electrical values, engine data, status, run time and counters, time, and remote control keys
source: SmartGen HGM7100N Genset Controller Communication Protocol, v1.3 (2025-06-21)
notes: Modbus RTU, 9600 bps 8N1 (2 stop bits selectable), address 1 to 255. Function 03 reads the holding registers, 06 writes only addresses 199 to 210 and 225 to 231, and 05 places the remote-control coils.
Addresses are decimal as in the manual, counted from 0. Alarm flags are bits of registers 0 to 35, the first listed item being bit 0 (LSB).
32-bit values (powers, energy, fuel, MCU ID) take two registers; the manual does not state the word order, so high word first is assumed.
Scaled values are marked in the manual with (*10) or (*100): the register holds the value times 10 or 100.
The manual gives no units; the usual units for this controller family (V, A, Hz, kW, kvar, kVA, rpm, %) are shown on the electrical values and may need checking.
Coils 5 and 6 differ between the models: close/open generator on the HGM7110N, change-over mains/gen on the HGM7120N.
Written from the manufacturer's protocol document; not tested on a device.
